notes.title: Patch 1.3 released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

A new patch has finally been released and we have some more (out of game) updates coming up soon! Here are the release notes:

[list]
[*]Fall forward acceleration decreased by 77%
[*]Missions now reset at 6 hour intervals.
[*]Plants Netupdate has been lowered increasing net performance
[*]Nodesystem bugfix for texture changes
[*]Default config altered to have good defaults
[*]As per community request, there is now a hole in the collision box leading out to the statue on ArgosArena
[*]Other minor fixes for game play and performance. 
[/list]

We've also released the complete [b]Lore[/b] for Epigenesis! Head over to the Lore subforum in our official Steam forum to read the events that led up to the games of Epigenesis, or why not check out the background for your favorite team?

MegOut();

notes.title: Patch 1.0 - Release patch!
notes.content:
HEYOOOOO!
So today we are releasing the 1.0 patch and leaving Early Access. Down under are the patch notes which includes the biggest changes in this patch. Furthermore, if you start up the game during this launch weekend you will get the exclusive [b]Trench Insignia skin[/b] for both Omani and Argos. This is a special skin and the promotion will end on [b]SUNDAY THE 3RD  24:00 CEST[/b]. We will be playing all night today so come on in and say hi! Cya ingame!


[b][h1]Patch 1.0[/h1][/b]

[b]General:[/b]
[b]- New: In-game store![/b]
Purchase new and exciting skins in our in-game store via mission points! Unlock skins for plants or hats for characters! Each plant has 2 unlockable skins per team and each team has 3 hats each!

- Available plant skins are:
[list]
[*]Trench Hologram Skin (Argos)
[*]Trench Insignia Skin (Argos)
[*]Trench Hologram Skin (Omani)
[*]Trench Insignia Skin (Omani)

[*]Turret Hologram Skin (Argos)                            
[*]Turret Gold Skin (Argos)
[*]Turret Hologram Skin (Omani)
[*]Turret Iron Skin (Omani)

[*]Ramp Hologram Skin (Argos)
[*]Ramp Gold Skin (Argos)
[*]Ramp Hologram Skin (Omani)
[*]Ramp Iron Skin (Omani)

[*]Shield Hologram Skin (Argos)                             
[*]Shield Metal Skin (Argos)       
[*]Shield Hologram Skin (Omani) 
[*]Shield Water Skin (Omani) 

[*]Smokescreen Hologram Skin (Argos)
[*]Smokescreen Ice Skin (Argos)
[*]Smokescreen Hologram Skin (Omani)  
[*]Smokescreen Lava Skin (Omani) 

[*]Mortar Hologram Skin (Argos) 
[*]Mortar Camo Skin (Argos)      
[*]Mortar Hologram Skin (Omani)
[*]Mortar Galaxy Skin (Omani)  
[/list]
[b]Available hats are:[/b][list]
[*]Crown (Argos)
[*]Wings (Argos)
[*]Featherheaddress (Argos)
[*]Bandana (Omani)
[*]BoxingHeadgear (Omani) 
[*]Scubagoggles (Omani) 
[/list]
[b]- New: Skin Manager![/b]
Access the Skin Manager from the Main Menu and use it to set which skin to use for each plant, as well as your character’s hat.


[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Polished texts on HUD, including but not limited to: End game stats, Score board, Team names and score numbers, respawn text and Main Menu texts.
[*]Added more animation to the Mission Popup.
[*]Changed the sound played when throwing a ball.
[*]Increased acceleration gliding, makes you able to fly further.  
[*]Changed the sound for hitconfirm.
[*]Added 2560x1440 resolution.
[*]Added wind sound when moving fast.
[*]Added and tweaked ambience in several maps.
[*]Updated Splash Screen with logos.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Turret now has correct animations in singeplayer.
[*]Characters now has correct default animations.
[*]Now giving correct number of passive buffs when capturing platforms with more than 2 connections.
[*]Jumping in mortar goo no longer spawns particles that doesn’t disappear.
[*]Smokescreen animation fix, no longer freezes after being planted for the first time.
[*]Fixed the bug where the ramp would slow you down instead of speeding you up.
[*]Fixed a bug where the plant indicators would freeze on screen if the player died with a seed.
[*]Chat window now receives focus properly each time it is opened.
[*]Minimap should now be properly displayed at all times.
[*]Fixed several bugs with the Mission System.
[*]Credits now rolls as usual.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.99
notes.content:
Greetings fierce warriors!

Hope you all are having a great summer! We are only a few days from launch and today we put out an updated containing some juicy stuff, including in-game missions! Missions will give you points that you can spend in the in-game store that will soon be released!

[h1]Patch 0.99[/h1]

[b]General:[/b][list]
[*]Added sound for when the ball hits the goalpost. Just so you can hear yourself fail
[*]Added “Plant Here” icons on HUD, active when carrying a seed
[*]Added an indicator on the HUD that shows which weapon the player is carrying
[*]New Team Select Screen implemented
[*]Added Missions! These are renewed each day and give you Mission Points which will be spendable in the in-game store (released at launch).
[/list]

[b]Removed:[/b][list]
[*]Join random team button
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Added a particle for when a plant is activated
[*]Added a particle for when a plant is deactivated
[*]Updated Omanis running and idle animations
[*]Changed graphics and placement of the Pickup icons on the HUD
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Foliage not spawning in singleplayer has been fixed
[*]Foliage slider in options menu now works
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.93
notes.content:
Patch notes for v0.93 right here!

Good summer on you all!

General:
- New: Implemented feature
Added Join Queue button in Main Menu, the button puts you in a queue that searches for available servers with players online. If no players were found, it puts you in an empty server and adds bots. As soon as someone joins the queue they will be put in your server
Added bot support and Singleplayer availability for LegacyArena, MixedArena and GranArena
Added button for Missions in Main Menu
Disabled button for Missions in Main Menu
Added flashy “Coming Soon!” text over Missions button in Main Menu
Added raspy sci-fi  voice for “5 minutes remaining”
Added raspy sci-fi  voice for “5… 4… 3… 2… 1…” MATCH OVER!

Changes:
Changed the graphics for “Press F1 to Ready”, “Ready” and “Countdown has begun!”  texts
Replaced “Got Shot” indicators with new graphics
Added Ball Respawned and Argos/Omani Made a Goal texts to HUD
Added Preview pictures of every map available in Singleplayer
Changed the graphics for the “Refresh Servers” spinning thing in the Multiplayer Menu
Made all of the buttons in the Customization Menu brighter
Changed default font on many buttons in Main Menu
Added yellow text in Customizations Menu to highlight important information

Bug fixes:
Fixed the wrong highlight color for Red loadouts in the Customization Menu

notes.title: Patch 0.9
notes.content:
Heyooo! Time for an update!

Here are the changes made in this last patch. We've adressed some balance issues but also polished some parts of the game. If you have any sort of feedback grab us in-game or on the forums!


[h1]Patch 0.9[/h1]

[b]General:[/b][list]
[*]Ball indicator on the HUD; tracks the ball and changes color depending on which team is carrying it
[*]Added info in pre-game about the loadouts the player has customized
[*]Added the ability to change the jump mechanic between Charge and Instant! In the loadouts, players can choose the standard Charge jump or an Instant jump which sends the player to a height equal to a Charge at level 2
[*]Speedlines when going really fast!
[*]Camera animations is now implemented, triggers when certain events occur such as jumping etc. You will be able to disable this in a later patch
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Bots easy mode is now easy
[*]Players gain extra Acceleration while falling allowing a small speed increase
[*]Minimap now has colored lines showing what platforms are linked
[*]Melee is now bound to rightclick by default (check keybindings)
[*]Methylation is now bound to ‘F’ by default (check keybindings)
[/list]

[b]Levels:[/b][list]
[*]GranArena is now reworked to work better with 3v3 games
[*]MixedArena now has more scenery
[*]You can no longer get out of bounds on ArgosArena
[*]Blastradius on LegacyArena is now fixed
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Ramp now increase speed by 400, down from 1000
[*]Player groundspeed is now 1860 by default, up from 1560
[*]Player airspeed is now 1860 by default, up from 1560
[*]Acceleration buff now gives 400, up from 300
[*]Aircontrol buff now gives 0.04, down from 0.06
[*]Speed buff now gives 50, down from 125
[*]Jump buff now gives 125-75(max-min), down from 150-100
[*]Railmode now has a max power of 2500, up from 2000
[*]Railmode now has a min power of 750, up from 600
[*]Poff shot now does 70% in outer radius of splash, up from 60%
[*]Plants are now automatically active when planted
[*]Turret shots no longer have pulling explosions
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Passive buff system is reworked and functions
[*]Chat commands no longer run on all clients at the same time
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2B
notes.content:
Heya Westleaf here!
We have been hard at work at the office and here are the latest patch notes coming in this update!

The biggest features of this update are:
- BOTS
- NEW GAME MODE (INSTAGIB)
- MORE ACHIEVEMENTS
- NEW UI
- NEW MAP (LEGACY ARENA)

Full notes below!

[u]General:[/u]
New feature: Bots[list]
[*]Bots have been added to Epigenesis by request from the community! 
[*]New feature: Singleplayer
[*]Setup a game through the new singleplayer-menu and battle against bots on Gadget arena and Omani arena
[/list]
New feature: Achievements[list]
[*] "Longshot" achievement for making a score from X distance (should be a pretty long distance)
[*]"Marksman" achiev for hitting with ten rails in a row
[*]"Not a beginner, not a pro" for winning 10 matches
[*]"Promode, activated!" for winning 500 matches
[*] "Tactician" for using every power-up in a single match
[*]"Iron Defence - Goal" for stealing the ball with a melee within X distance from your goal (should be on the spawn-platform)
[*]"Desecrate Omani Homelands" for winning 10 times as Argos on OmaniArena
[*]"Desecrate Argos Homelands" for winning 10 times as Omani on ArgosArena
[*]"Hattrick!" for when a player does 3 goals in a single match
[/list]
New game mode: Instagib[list]
[*]Play the classic game mode “instagib” in Epigenesis. Selective servers will be hosting this free-for-all game mode!
[*]This is instagib v.01 and we’ll need further development. Feedback is always welcome on our forums!
[/list]
New map: Legacy Arena[list]
[*]Battle on this new medium-large map that have a wide range of jump difficulties.This map features a lot of line-of-sight
[/list]
[u]Changes:[/u][list]
[*]Major update to all HUD elements and menus
[*]Changed placement of Loadout icons in pre-game
[*]The smokescreen on Mixed Arena and Argos Arena will now fade in and out instead of just disappearing
[*]Changed banners back to Argos and Omani characters
[*]The team flags now have cloth physics. The flag can’t interact with players and/or the ball due to performance issues 
[*]The shockwave pickup should now be able to push players down if they are below you.
[*]Added a sound for when a player melees another player
[*]Powerups will be available in the warm up and will respawn when the match begins
[*]Added sound for buttons in menues
[*]Added showcase for Plants and Buffs in Customization menu
[*]Added text below the status-heads for the teams (HUD)
[*]Added a sound when players hit with melee
[/list]
[u]Levels:[/u][list]
[*]Added particle for flying platforms on Gran Arena
[/list]
[u]Balance Changes:[/u][list]
[*]The Methylation beam is a bit longer
[*]The Methylation beam appear directly once the right mouse button is pressed. 
[*]The smokescreens smoke is bigger
[*]The smokescreens detection range is bigger
[*]Increased the time between shots for the Turret from 1 to 2
[/list]
[u]Bug fixes:[/u][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the ball sometimes had a snowball-material. 
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could hear other players welcome sound
[*]Fixed a bug where the menu didn’t disappear when the player pressed “resume”
[*]Fixed scaling bug for Grapple icon (HUD)
[*]Fixed the “Welcome” sound bug
[*]Powerups now spawn in warm-up
[/list]

notes.title: New map, plant and music
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, as promised, we have a new level, a plant and music track for everyone to try out and listen to in this weekend’s game nights!

[b]The new level, GranArena,[/b] has actually been up for a couple of weeks for community testing and has had some art passes and balance fixes made to it since. The level is larger than our ordinary maps which makes it better suited for 4v4 and 5v5 games. It also features jump pads with larger height differences!

[b]The new plant, called the Trench,[/b] is now selectable from the Customize Menu. The Trench creates a force field which is carried by friendly players, protecting them from harm. Use it to capture those hard to reach platforms while avoiding enemy fire!

[b]Finally, the new music track is called The Chase.[/b] It features epic guitar riffs and a speedy tempo which ensures lots of adrenaline rushes while you fight to secure those goals. Having Alexander Brandon as the main source of inspiration for the music, prepare to get flashbacks to the early Unreal Tournament tracks while listening to this!

The Chase, as well as every other track featured in Epigenesis, can be found on our Soundcloud: https://soundcloud.com/deadsharkaudio

[b]Remember![/b]

[b]Scrim Night[/b] – This Saturday (tomorrow!) at 18:00 CET. Come online and play, talk to us on TeamSpeak! We will be streaming and commenting your games!

[b]Dev Game Night[/b] – Every Sunday at 20:00 CET. Come online and play with the developers, join us on TeamSpeak and tell us what you think about the new features!

Official TeamSpeak 3 server: voice.deadsharktriplepunch.com

See you in-game!

- Michael ‘Mahkul’ Levall, Project Lead at DS3P

Originally posted on [url=http://deadsharktriplepunch.com/epigenesis/?p=715]our site[/url].

notes.title: Patch 0.26
notes.content:
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]- New: Plant - Mortar
This plant shoots blobs that stick on the ground or in the air depending on where the impact is.
When near this blob you can’t use your thruster.
When you go outside of the blob your jumps get restored (the same applies when in the air) to the amount you had when you walked into the blob.
Known bug: Jump Arrows are not removed while standing in the blob.
[*]- New: Tutorial
There is now a small single-player tutorial in the game which takes a player through the very basics of the game.
The tutorial explains things such as movement, win-conditions, seeds and plants.
Fully voice acted.
Known bug: If multiple voices are triggered, they get layered. 
[/list]
[b]- Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed the experience bar from the Customize Menu
[*]RoundTime and ReadyDelay from Config.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Railgun rework: The velocity applied is now towards the shooting player rather than away from the shooting player. (Yes this still works on teammates, the ball and enemies.)
[*]Players with pickups now have a small particle floating around them to indicate which pickup they are carrying (red, green and yellow).
[*]Rocket Jumping is now totally doable (very experimental)
[*]Added cooldown indication on HUD for Grapple.
[*]Added tutorial button in the Main Menu
[*]Reworked the layout of the Customize Menu
[*]Added credit screen to the Main Menu 
[*]Updated Omanis ground, ramp and building roots textures
[*]Updated Melee animation
[*]Added color-coded buff count on the HUD for Argos and Omani.
[*]You can now see both of the teams passive buffs at any given time, not just your own.
[*]Added a melee animation for third person.
[/list]

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated post processing in Argos Arena
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Poff(rocket) now has a slightly stronger knockback and lesser falloff.
[*]Poff now goes faster (up from 8000 to 10000)
[*]Poff explosion radius is now greater (up from 350 to 400)
[*]Railgun now has a greater cooldown (up from 0.8 to 1.5)
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players were able to grab the ball just after a goal was made.
[*]Fixed an issue where some players had their camera inverted.
[*]You now choose team before you spawn in instead of after you spawn.
[*]The auto ready problem which caused games to start before all player had readied is fixed!

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Alot was added under the hood this patch. There will be bugs.
[list]

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.24
notes.content:
General:
* New: Loadout System
	- You can now customize your loadout of seeds
	- Each player gets 3 seed slots
	- Each seed slot can have one plant with a passive attached
	- These are the seeds you get when you score a goal

Removed:
* Removed weapon-mode UI icons.
* Removed foliage for now, expect a reworked edition soon. Reason: Slowing down servers.

Changes:
* The thruster(jump) now has redesigned UI elements.
* Moved UI jump-charge meter and changed graphic.
* You can now access the Options Menu from the in-game and spectator Pause Menu
* Changed color on all pickups
* Added tutorial animals to the Main Menu
* Updated the first-person models (textures are work in progress)
* Updated pickup mesh to have the same color as the pickup
* Updated colors for the pickups
* Updated colors of the Pickups symbols on the HUD
* Updated graphic and layout of the Join Game Menu & Customize Menu
* You can now do a 1 jump by pressing Ctrl
* The ball now properly reacts to the jump pad
* Added animation for melee (stealing the ball)
* Changed Pickup radius

Levels:
* Added scenery to Argos Arena
* Created collision on Waterfall on Argos Arena

Balance Changes:
* Turret: Projectiles is now a tiny bit weaker.
	- The pull-force is reduced from 2000 to 1850
	- The push-force is reduced from 10000 to 8500
	- Radius of push is reduced from 1000 to 750 to match the pull

Bug fixes:
* You can no longer stand inside the goal or pick up the ball before it respawns after a goal
* Several other minor fixes

Other:
* Improved security
* Added more server options (Work in progress)
	- Type Help in the console for full list of commands.
	- Map rotation is now in.
